name: Norma Rios Sierra
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 3A

items.text: Norma Rios Sierra is a Chicago Board of Education member for District 3A. She works as a special projects manager for the Chicago Park District. Appointed in 2024, she previously organized with Palenque LSNA and served on a Local School Council. On the board, she voted for a budget that relied on $150 million in additional state funding, and she voted to protect immigrant students and to plan for charter school closures. She also served on a working group to pick the new Chicago Public Schools CEO.

items.text: After a budget vote in August 2025, she shouted “Free Palestine” at a Jewish board member during a recess. Jewish community groups condemned the remark and called for her resignation.
